title: CURATE: BENCHMARKING PERSONALISED ALIGNMENT OF CONVERSATIONAL AI ASSISTANTS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating AI assistants' ability to adhere to user-specific safety constraints such as allergies, phobias, and physical limitations. While it operates within the field of AI safety and alignment—which has ethical foundations—the benchmark itself does not evaluate or measure religion, theological doctrines, or specific systems of moral philosophy.
